lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct, high-contrast white vertical lines are visible. Spacing is irregular, with narrower intervals in the posterior section and wider gaps in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal termination of the seventh stripe from the anterior edge. A second merging point is observed at the top of the ninth stripe.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The fourth and tenth stripes (counting anterior to posterior) are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density; a single primary high-contrast circular white spot is located on the upper posterior haunch, with two faint, smaller spots located inferiorly near the hind limb junction.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Straight, conical trajectory angled approximately 40 degrees posterior relative to the skull's vertical axis; lacks the mature lyrate curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; a white chevron marking between the eyes; a white patch at the base of the throat; and prominent white banding on the inner and outer surfaces of the lower limbs above the hooves.
